notes: The Copenhagen Card (72 hours, 889 DKK) covers transport and museums, including Louisiana, Kronborg and Roskilde, and pays for itself on this plan. Bikes cost 100-150 per day and the city is flat. The metro to the airport takes 15 minutes.
Winter is 0-5°C and dark by 16:00. For hygge: Tivoli at Christmas (November to December), Louisiana and cafes. Reffen is closed. Cherry blossom at Bispebjerg in April and May.
Coffee is 45 DKK, smørrebrød 90-150, a restaurant meal 250-400 and a beer 60. No tipping. Cards are accepted everywhere (no cash needed).
Nordic cuisine: Noma has closed, but there are Geranium and Alchemist. Budget options: Hija de Sanchez, Gasoline Grill burgers, and the Juno and Hart bakeries.
Follow the photo rule in Christiania (none on a green light). Pusher Street is closed. Don't walk in the bike lane (cyclists will ring their bells).
Kronborg and Louisiana are covered by the Copenhagen Card. Tivoli's lights come on after 17:00 in the evening.

transit.name: Copenhagen Card
transit.why_chosen: 80+ museums plus all public transport (including Louisiana, Kronborg and Roskilde). 3 days for 889 DKK.
transit.coverage: Metro, S-tog, otobüs, liman otobüsü, bölgesel tren

stops.name: Nyhavn
stops.tips: Colourful 17th-century harbour. Andersen lived at No. 20. Quiet in the morning, and canal tours depart from here.

stops.name: Canal Tour Copenhagen
stops.tips: One-hour canal tour (Stromma or the cheaper Netto). See the Little Mermaid from the water, plus the Opera House and Christianshavn.

stops.name: Amalienborg Palace
stops.tips: The royal residence. The changing of the guard is at 12:00, and the Marble Church dome is nearby.

stops.name: Torvehallerne
stops.tips: Glass market at Nørreport: Hallernes smørrebrød (open sandwich), Grød porridge and Coffee Collective.

stops.name: Round Tower
stops.tips: Round tower from 1642 with a spiral ramp and views over the city.

backups.name: Schønnemann
backups.tips: A smørrebrød institution since 1877. Book ahead; try the herring and schnapps.

backups.name: Designmuseum Danmark
backups.tips: Corridor of Danish design chairs. An alternative to the Round Tower.

stops.name: Rosenborg Castle
stops.tips: Renaissance castle with the Crown Jewels in the basement, set beside the King's Garden.

stops.name: Kongens Have
stops.tips: A winter stroll through the gardens.

stops.name: Statens Museum for Kunst
stops.tips: The national gallery: Matisse and the Danish Golden Age.

stops.name: Aamanns 1921
stops.tips: Modern smørrebrød. Book ahead.

stops.name: Tivoli Gardens
stops.tips: Amusement park and gardens from 1843, said to have inspired Disney. Lights in the evening and free summer concerts on Fridays. Entry is 175 plus a ride ticket. In winter it runs Christmas and Halloween seasons.

backups.name: Tivoli Food Hall
backups.tips: Food hall next to the park. No entry ticket needed.

backups.name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
backups.tips: Rodin, Gauguin and a winter garden. An alternative to SMK, and free on Tuesdays.

stops.name: Church of Our Saviour
stops.tips: Tower with an external spiral staircase of 400 steps, overlooking the Christianshavn canals.

stops.name: Freetown Christiania
stops.tips: Hippie autonomous district founded in 1971. Pusher Street was closed (2024). Follow the photo rule. Cafes and Grå Hal.

stops.name: Reffen Street Food
stops.tips: Reffen is closed in winter. Go to Broens Gadekøkken (under the bridge) or La Banchina instead.

stops.name: Copenhagen Opera House
stops.tips: Henning Larsen's opera house on Holmen. See it from the outside.

stops.name: Copenhill Amager Bakke
stops.tips: Ski slope and walking trail on the roof of a waste-to-energy plant. The city views are free.

backups.name: Christianshavns Bådudlejning
backups.tips: Cafe on the canal, with boat hire.

backups.name: Danish Architecture Center BLOX
backups.tips: Architecture centre with a slide. An alternative to Copenhill.

stops.name: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art
stops.tips: 35 minutes by train (Humlebæk). Giacometti, Kusama and a sculpture garden overlooking the Øresund, among the world's most beautiful museums.

stops.name: Louisiana Café
stops.tips: Museum cafe with sea views and a smørrebrød buffet.

stops.name: Kronborg Castle
stops.tips: In Helsingør: Hamlet's Elsinore, with Holger Danske in the casemates and the Swedish coast across the water.

stops.name: Helsingør Old Town
stops.tips: Medieval streets and the Maritime Museum (BIG). Take the train back.

backups.name: Brasserie Kronborg
backups.tips: On Helsingør harbour, beside the castle.

backups.name: Karen Blixen Museum Rungstedlund
backups.tips: Home of the author of Out of Africa. On the way to Louisiana, as an alternative to Kronborg.

stops.name: Carlsberg Byen
stops.tips: Former brewery district with the Elephant Gate and Home of Carlsberg (visitor centre 130 DKK).

stops.name: Frederiksberg Gardens
stops.tips: Romantic park and palace. Take a canal boat, and you can spot the zoo's elephants.

stops.name: Værnedamsvej
stops.tips: The 'Little Paris' street: granola brunch, a cheesemonger and a wine shop.

stops.name: Kødbyen Meatpacking
stops.tips: The White Meatpacking District, with galleries and evening bars.

stops.name: Warpigs Kødbyen
stops.tips: Mikkeller x Three Floyds beer and Texas BBQ.

backups.name: Copenhagen Zoo
backups.tips: Zoo in Frederiksberg with an elephant house by Norman Foster.

stops.name: Assistens Kirkegård
stops.tips: Cemetery-park where Andersen and Kierkegaard are buried, by the yellow wall of Nørrebro.

stops.name: Superkilen Park
stops.tips: BIG's red-and-black multicultural park, with a Moroccan fountain and a Thai boxing ring.

stops.name: Jægersborggade
stops.tips: Nørrebro's hip street: Grød, Meyers Bageri and Coffee Collective.

stops.name: Viking Ship Museum Roskilde
stops.tips: 25 minutes by train. Five original Viking ships and the fjord. In summer (May to September) you can go aboard a ship.

stops.name: Roskilde Cathedral
stops.tips: Burial place of 40 Danish monarchs. UNESCO-listed brick Gothic.

backups.name: Frederiksborg Castle Hillerød
backups.tips: Renaissance castle on a lake, with the Museum of National History. An alternative to Roskilde.

stops.name: Kastellet
stops.tips: Star-shaped fortress and windmill. Morning joggers.

stops.name: The Little Mermaid
stops.tips: Statue from 1913 at Langelinie. Small and crowded, but a must.

stops.name: Gefion Fountain & St Alban's
stops.tips: Fountain with oxen and the English church.

stops.name: Juno the Bakery Østerbro
stops.tips: The city's best bakery. Try the kardemommebolle (cardamom bun) with a farewell coffee.

stops.name: Østerport Metro Airport
stops.tips: Metro or train to Kastrup takes 15 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Nyboder
backups.tips: Yellow sailors' houses. An alternative to the fountain.
